seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA). From 1-Jan-2022 MA revenue is reported by Decision Solutions (DS) / Research and Insights (R&I) / Data and Information (D&I), replacing RD&A / ERS; prior-year (2021) LOB revenue recast by the company. MIS LOBs: Corporate Finance, Structured Finance, Financial Institutions, Public, Project and Infrastructure Finance, MIS Other. Segment Adjusted Operating Income (release segment table) = total segment revenue incl. intersegment less Operating + SG&A; it excludes D&A and restructuring. MIS intersegment revenue = royalty charged to MA (10-K: 'Intersegment royalty'). mis_dna/ma_dna/mis_restr/ma_restr from the release segment table. Recurring/transaction split and LOB revenue from the release Table 'Transaction and Recurring Revenue'. seg.legacy holds the 10-Q/10-K sub-LOB detail (CFG/SFG/FIG/PPIF sub-lines).

extra.notes: Employees 14,426 at 31-Dec-2022 (MIS 5,519; MA 7,122; MSS 1,785). kompany: purchase price "not material" (10-Q Note); partly paid in shares (44 non-cash, 0.1m shares) with cash in "Cash paid for acquisitions, net of cash acquired" (97 for FY2022 in total, which also includes 1 of PassFort post-closing consideration); consideration left null (not published). Debt 2022: issued 500 3.75% Senior Notes due 2052 (1Q22) and 500 4.25% Senior Notes due 2032 (3Q22) (Issuance of notes 988 net); repaid 500 2.625% 2017 Senior Notes due 2023 via tender (3Q22) and early-redeemed 200 principal of 2.55% 2020 Senior Notes due 2060 for 126 (Dec-2022, gain 70) (Repayment of notes 626). Restructuring: 2022-2023 Geolocation Restructuring Program approved 30-Jun-2022 (scope expanded Oct-2022): FY2022 charge 113 (employee termination 85, real estate 27 incl. ROU / leasehold impairment and accelerated amortization of abandoned assets, other 1) plus 2020 programs net 1 = 114; expected annualized savings 100-135. Russia: ceased commercial operations in 2022; 20 FX translation losses reclassified to earnings (non-deductible). No goodwill impairment. Revolver 1,250 undrawn (matures Dec-2026); no CP.
